mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits metabolism of nortriptyline via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially increasing tricyclic antidepressant plasma concentrations and cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor nortriptyline levels and cardiac function (ECG, QTc interval); consider dose reduction of nortriptyline if co-administered; counsel on increased anticholinergic and CNS depression symptoms.
